evidence: Film Growth: Tin disulfide thin films were deposited using a commercial, hot wall flow-type F120 ALD reactor operating at a pressure of ≈5 mbar. Nitrogen (N 2, AGA, 99.999%) was used as both carrier and purge gas at a flow rate of 400 sccm. Unless otherwise noted, the films were deposited at 150 °C using 1 s Sn(OAc) 4 and 4 s H2S pulses separated by 2 s N 2 purges.
